body_text: Inspired by the Super3 approach and thoughtfully adapted for young children, our inquiry cycle helps children learn naturally through curiosity and hands-on play.
title: Create (Action & Play)
text: Children test their theories, build with open-ended materials and bring their imaginations to life.
text_2: Children meet new ideas, ask questions and investigate their surroundings through nature, stories and play.
text_3: Children look back at what they made, talk about their discoveries and celebrate their learning with teachers and peers.
